how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-maraudon-01-r2.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:7068:completion:0: Ah, these be perfect for me magics. Here, you take one of these trinkets and be on your way... me got much studyin' to do.

rows.quest:7070:progress:0: Have you made the trip yet? I realize it'd be quite dangerous, but if you were successful, it would very much be worth it.
rows.quest:7070:completion:0: These are perfect, ⟦1⟧. I actually had other adventurers return from there also and from them I was able to fashion these... please, feel free to take one for your hard work. And thank you again for more samples to study.

rows.quest:7067:obj:0: Read the Pariah's Instructions. Afterwards, obtain the ⟦E19⟧ from ⟦E2⟧ and return it to the ⟦E20⟧ in southern ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:7067:details:0: Though exiled as a heretic, my beliefs still ring true--that alone drives me onward. But for my destiny to be complete, I need the aid of an outsider... one not of any centaur tribe.
rows.quest:7067:details:1: The task requires someone to enter the holy halls of ⟦E2⟧--a tomb my people protect, and only the most devout are ever allowed to enter.
rows.quest:7067:details:2: If you agree to aid me, then you need only nod. I will pass you a parchment with my instructions on it. Read it over and consider my words.
rows.quest:7067:progress:0: What did you decide, ⟦11⟧? Can you help me? Will you set foot on holy ground to help me forge one great centaur tribe!?
rows.quest:7067:completion:0: This is it, ⟦12⟧! This is it! Now I can begin the great task of uniting the tribes. Thank you.
rows.quest:7067:completion:1: Take this for your efforts, please. I hope when next we meet, it will be on much different terms.

rows.quest:7044:details:0: A dark satyr called Lord Vyletongue spread his evil through these twisting caves, poisoning the minds of all inside. He still resides beyond the purple crystals.
rows.quest:7044:details:1: Vyletongue also created a living symbol of his corruption called ⟦E26⟧ that dwells beyond the orange crystals. Together, they have stolen the two parts of my brother's scepter. ⟦E25⟧, my brother... he wanders blindly inside, cursed by corruption.
rows.quest:7044:details:2: You must help him! Find the pieces, and speak to my brother... somehow.
rows.quest:7044:progress:0: I have awoken from a nightmare that seemed it would never end...
rows.quest:7044:completion:0: Now that you have recovered the two parts of my scepter, I have hope that ⟦E2⟧ may one day be rid of the Vyle corruption.
rows.quest:7046:obj:1: Speak with him when the ritual is complete.
rows.quest:7046:details:0: My scepter was once a source of hope for me. Its power allowed me the freedom to travel quickly through these caverns. I had hoped to bring peace to the spirit of my uncle... It is a task that I now pass to you.
rows.quest:7046:details:1: For the two parts to once again become one, I will need your assistance in performing the ritual. Please follow me, and listen to my instructions while I channel the energy required to reunite the rod with the diamond.
rows.quest:7046:details:2: Together, we shall create the ⟦E22⟧ once again!
rows.quest:7046:progress:0: If you wish to restart the ritual, please abandon our first attempt and then speak to me again.
rows.quest:7046:completion:0: Please take this, and know that the power allotted to you now must be used for good. Continue your journey through the caverns, and with hope, you will find the remains of my uncle. Much danger awaits you, ⟦13⟧.
rows.quest:7046:completion:1: Speak with me again should the need arise.

rows.quest:7066:obj:0: Seek out Remulos in ⟦E35⟧ and give him the ⟦E36⟧.
rows.quest:7066:details:0: The misbegotten centaur--my sons and daughters--have need of their father.
rows.quest:7066:details:1: Look around you--this place rings of hope and all that my father Cenarius preaches. It sprung from me! And I cannot take that away from them... not even for their crimes against me.
rows.quest:7066:details:2: But there is one thing I would ask of you to ease my brother's mind. Take this... it is the first seed that fell from the life my remains nourished. Tell him my spirit remains here, and that I live on. I am sure he will understand.
rows.quest:7066:progress:0: You have the scent of corruption on you, ⟦25⟧... much like many adventurers these days. But something about you is different. Is there something you've come to speak to me about? You have an aura about you that seems familiar, but I cannot place it.⟦26⟧⟦27⟧Please, I implore you, tell me why you've sought an audience with me.
rows.quest:7066:completion:0: So my brother has finally found peace? I am proud to have lived to see this day. In all his arrogance and anger, I truly thought he was lost to us, but this... this symbol of his sacrifice only proves that he is not lost--he has only been reborn. He takes his place in nature as was his duty.
rows.quest:7066:completion:1: Thank you, ⟦28⟧. By bringing this to me, you have secured a small amount of hope that I thought I had once lost. This seed will be important to the people of this war-torn land some day... I can sense it.
